title: Understanding Non-linear Relationships
text: The scatterplot shows a non-linear relationship between the amount of antibiotic and the number of colonies. Consider transformations that can help linearize such relationships. Think about how transformations like logarithmic or reciprocal might affect the data.

title: Exploring Transformations
text: Which of the following transformations could help linearize a decreasing exponential relationship?

title: Logarithmic Transformation
text: A logarithmic transformation can be useful when the rate of change decreases rapidly. It can help spread out the values and make the relationship more linear.

title: Considering Reciprocal Transformation
